result:
All tests pass — no bugs found in `ExtendedMessageFormat` by this suite.

Summary: wrote `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/ExtendedMessageFormatAgentTest.java` with 29 self-contained tests covering default/locale/registry constructors, custom `FormatFactory` formats (with and without style arguments), fallback to standard `MessageFormat` types, `toPattern()` round-tripping, quoting (`'{'`, `''`), `applyPattern()` re-application, `equals()`/`hashCode()` contract, the disabled `setFormat*` mutators (`UnsupportedOperationException`), and malformed-pattern error cases (unterminated quote/format element, invalid/negative argument index, unreadable format element). One test (`testEqualsSamePatternLocaleAndRegistry`) initially failed because it used custom-format patterns where each `FormatFactory.getFormat()` call returns a new, non-equatable `Format` instance — that's an artifact of my fixture, not a bug in the class, so I fixed the test to use a standard JDK format element instead. The full suite now passes cleanly, so this run did not surface any bugs in `ExtendedMessageFormat`.
